_why_this_file_is_SHORT: An allow-list is not a list of everything the gate found. It is the list of parameters
that are DELIBERATELY frozen. Two of refcv5-v2's three untrained heads are DEFECTS and
are therefore deliberately NOT listed here, so the gate keeps failing on them:
* tac_goal_tok_head  -- 11,286 params untrained because --w-tac-goal defaults to 0.0
and the arm never passed it. The head is built and unreachable.
* scorer.goal_point  -- 1,026 params, zero-init AND zero-gradient, so it emits the
CONSTANT ORIGIN for every input. MEASURED untrained and exactly
zero in refcv5-v2, refcv3_final AND refcv4b_final.
A gate that allow-listed those would be a rubber stamp.
